notes.title: Sparkles & Gems Demo is now available!
notes.notes: Now available at your local jewellery store, it’s the Sparkles & Gems Demo! Play a vivacious game of gem-smashing fun and discover some of the sparkley personalities of the unique characters in the game. Sparkles & Gems offers an experience like no other game before it, and with a demo now available, you can get a taste of the magic within. Mmmm, tastes splendiferic!

notes.title: New Feature: Gem Colours!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We're briefly returning to Sparkles & Gems with a brand new feature! It's the ability to swap to new gem colour schemes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40226952/016d45afea87e7890943ae7c882ef7c168475b77.png[/img]

To access it from the main menu, go to "Extras" then "Customize Game Rules" and the new setting will be at the bottom!

There are 10 new colour schemes in total:
Capricorn
Opulent
Ethereal
RGBY
Monochrome
Spring
Aqua
Fabulous
Flat Black
Flat White

notes.title: New Game from Sparkles & Gems dev - Stardust Demon!!!
notes.notes:
Here's our new game!! It's a retro metroidvania. Check it out and wishlist here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2815500/Stardust_Demon/

It features a combination of 2D pixel art and 3D old-skool art for cutscenes, and a lot of silliness like Sparkles & Gems and cool music! If you like our work, wishlisting really helps us out and enables us to do more. Thank you!!

notes.title: Version 1.02... + Soundtrack Released!
notes.notes:
The soundtrack is now out!! Exciting!!
We are also working with Fourth Strike Records to release a limited run of physical [b]cassette[/b] tapes of the soundtrack, which we are super excited about!! You can pre-order a copy now at the soundtrack bandcamp page - https://resni.bandcamp.com/album/sparkles-gems-soundtrack

Also there's a few fixes to the game itself:

[i]Changelog:[/i]

- "Softie Meow" changed to "Softie" on win screen & text colour fixed
- Fixed panning issue in Sandway's theme music
- Toy bus is visible inside room after you've collected it
- one of the songs is EQ'd

notes.title: Music Stuff - Version 1.01b
notes.notes:
Small update where a couple music tracks were fleshed out more. These were the only things that felt unfinished to me in the soundtrack, now we'll work on making an OST album available for download too some time!

Changelog:
New section at the end of Sandway's theme
A few seconds of guitar solo added to Softie's theme
